components.name: Evidence panel
components.html:
Recorded evidence

Source and recording limits remain adjacent to the result.

narrative.overview: Deep navy chrome and cool layered surfaces hold precise sans text, tabular values and restrained blue selection. Written states and adjacent source detail carry meaning; color reinforces them. The light theme preserves the same hierarchy with pale surfaces and darker text.
keyCharacteristics: Compact operational controls and consistent thin boundaries.
Readable identifiers, numeric columns and source panels.
Bounded selection motion with a reduced-motion alternative.
dos: Do keep source detail and recorded coverage visible beside conclusions.
Do use written semantic states alongside color.
Do preserve keyboard focus, reduced motion and reader-controlled feed updates.
donts: Don't turn missing USD values into zero.
Don't imply a filtered graph or truncated recording is complete.
Don't add decorative neon or generic hero tiles.
